theme.title: Cup nights
theme.subtitle: The In-Season Tournament and NBA Cup
theme.recap: The new in-season event produced its own record nights, plus a prize of half a million dollars a player.

questions.prompt: How many points did Anthony Davis score in the first In-Season Tournament final?
questions.context: 2023 In-Season Tournament final · Lakers vs Pacers

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Anthony Davis finished with 41 points on 16-for-24 shooting, 20 rebounds and 4 blocks;

funFacts.text: Davis also grabbed 20 rebounds and blocked four shots in the inaugural Cup title game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Anthony Davis recorded 41 points, 20 rebounds, 5 assists and 4 blocks

funFacts.text: LeBron James won the overall tournament MVP award even though Davis starred in the final.

source.quote: LeBron James was named the Most Valuable Player for the tournament
